question: Should runtime localization localize gateway JSON `message` and `reason` fields, or should those protocol-facing fields remain stable while only UI/display surfaces translate them?
rationale: The diff changes fields that clients may consume as text, and tests cannot settle whether those gateway fields are product-supported display strings or compatibility-sensitive protocol text.

options.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
options.body: Translate chat/UI display copy but keep gateway JSON message/reason fields stable unless a separate documented display contract is added.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Fields
options.body: Treat those JSON strings as display-only and require focused docs/tests showing clients must use stable code/type fields for branching.

options.title: Pause Gateway Runtime I18n
options.body: Limit this PR to channel/TUI/runtime reply copy and defer gateway JSON localization to a narrower maintainer-owned decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
recommendation.body: Translate chat/UI display copy but keep gateway JSON message/reason fields stable unless a separate documented display contract is added.
